summary: Renames the public auth-strategy config field of @cipherstash/stack from `config.strategy` to `config.authStrategy` on both the Node `Encryption()` entry and the `wasm-inline` entry, keeping `strategy` as a deprecated alias that still forwards (authStrategy wins when both are set) and logs a once-per-process console warning. The rest is TypeDoc. The public `Encryption()` path is backward compatible and the alias, precedence and warning behaviour are covered by new unit tests (not run here; no CI given). The one hard rename is the parameter of `EncryptionClient.init()` (marked @internal but reachable through the `@cipherstash/stack/encryption` subpath): a direct JS caller still passing `strategy` would have it silently dropped and fall back to the default `auto` credentials. No in-repo caller does this. Minor: test-only latch-reset functions are exported from two public entry points, and AGENTS.md still documents `config.strategy`. No payload, key, or SQL contract changes.

behaviour_changes.description: Node `ClientConfig` gains `authStrategy?: AuthStrategy`; `strategy` stays as a @deprecated alias. `Encryption()` resolves `authStrategy ?? strategy` and forwards it to protect-ffi `newClient({ strategy })` unchanged.
`EncryptionClient.init()` parameter renamed from `strategy` to `authStrategy` with no alias; only `config.authStrategy` is forwarded to newClient.

wasm-inline `WasmClientConfig` union gains an `authStrategy` arm and a deprecated `strategy` arm; `resolveStrategy` uses `authStrategy ?? strategy`, keeps the accessKey mutual-exclusion guard and names the field the caller set in its error message.
Passing the deprecated `strategy` (alone or together with `authStrategy`) emits one `console.warn` per process per entry point.
New exported functions `__resetStrategyDeprecationWarningForTests` in `encryption/index.ts` and `wasm-inline.ts`, both modules that are published package entry points.
Expanded TypeDoc for `Encryption()` and `ClientConfig` covering auto strategy, CS_* env vars, custom strategies, lock context and keysets.

failure_scenarios.title: Direct EncryptionClient.init({ strategy }) callers silently fall back to the default auto credentials
failure_scenarios.trigger: A consumer (plain JS, or TS passing a non-literal/spread config) constructs `new EncryptionClient()` from `@cipherstash/stack/encryption` and calls `init({ ..., strategy })` as worked at base.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: `init()` now reads only `config.authStrategy` (encryption/index.ts:130,166); a `strategy` key is ignored with no warning or error, so protect-ffi receives `strategy: undefined` and builds its default auto strategy from CS_* env vars or the dev profile. The deprecated-alias handling lives only in `Encryption()` (encryption/index.ts:864-867).
failure_scenarios.consequence: ZeroKMS requests authenticate as the service/env credentials instead of the intended strategy (e.g. an end user's OidcFederationStrategy). Without lock context, encryption may succeed under the wrong identity; with lock context it would likely fail at operation time. If no env credentials exist, init fails loudly.

evidence.claim: init() accepts `authStrategy` (no `strategy`) and forwards only `config.authStrategy` to newClient as `strategy`.
Encryption() warns when `strategy` is set, resolves `authStrategy ?? strategy`, and passes it to init after spreading clientConfig.
`./encryption` is a published subpath export pointing at dist/encryption/index.
Only two non-test init() callers in the repo: stack Encryption() (encryption/index.ts:878) and protect (ProtectClient, unrelated).
Tests forward of authStrategy, alias forwarding with warning, precedence when both set, and no warning for authStrategy alone — all via Encryption().
Tests resolveStrategy for authStrategy, deprecated alias, precedence, and the accessKey mutual-exclusion error naming the set field.
resolveStrategy uses `authStrategy ?? strategy`, warns on strategy, and keeps runtime guards.
WasmClientConfig union now has accessKey, authStrategy (+optional deprecated strategy) and deprecated-strategy-only arms.
Once-per-process warn latch and exported `__resetStrategyDeprecationWarningForTests` (mirrored at wasm-inline.ts:401-422).
